svg.text: SROT Node v1 — Universal ESP32 Node (Sentinel / Scout / Quality / Tank)
Net-label schematic: every flag with the same name is the same wire. All grounds common. Analog sensors are 5 V; everything entering the ESP32/ADS1115 is ≤ 3.3 V.
A. POWER (USB power bank or 5 V phone charger)
J1 USB 5 V in: power bank via a USB-A to screw-terminal adapter
ESP32 is powered from +5V through its 5V pin.
Do not also plug its USB port into a PC while
+3V3 comes from the ESP32 DevKit's on-board regulator (500 mA budget:
ADS1115 x2, DS3231, GPS, DS18B20). Never feed 5 V into any ESP32 GPIO.
Draw is about 0.2-0.3 A: a 10,000 mAh power bank lasts roughly 1 day.
Use a power bank without auto-off (or with a low-current mode).
The +5V rail is also the reference for the ratiometric pressure sensors.
ADS1_RDY is open-drain and GPIO34 has no internal pull-up, so R18 is required.
TDS module output (0–2.3 V) goes straight to ADS #2 A2 — no divider (only C9 100nF).
C. MCU — ESP32-WROOM-32 DevKitC V4 (38-pin, USB at bottom)
GPIO0 = on-board BOOT button (hold 3 s → setup mode)
GPIO12 left free: strapping pin, must be LOW at boot.
GPIO 6–11 are the SPI flash — never connect.
UART naming is from the module's side: GPS_TXD = GPS TX → ESP RX (16).
MODEM_TXD = modem TX → ESP RX (32); MODEM_RXD = ESP TX (33) → modem RX.
D. PROBE POWER SWITCHES + SOLENOID DRIVER
GPIO HIGH → NPN on → gate pulled to GND → P-FET on → probe powered.
Only one electrochemical probe is powered at a time (pH and TDS interfere).
E. ADC, CLOCK, GPS, STORAGE, MODEM
NEO-6M boards: PPS is often only wired to the LED —
solder a wire to the LED's resistor pad or use an M8N board with a PPS pin.
A7670C bare modules use 1.8 V UART — buy a breakout with level shifting.
F. FIELD SENSORS (3-pin screw terminals / JST-XH)
JSN-SR04T: VCC +5V, GND, TRIG → FLOW2_SIG terminal, ECHO → FLOW1_SIG terminal
(the existing 10k/20k dividers make both pins 3.3 V-safe).
PZEM-004T v3: TTL side 5V pin → +3V3, TX → GPS_TXD, RX → GPS_RXD.
Mains side of the PZEM must be wired by an electrician.
What to populate per node role (same PCB / perfboard):
U2 + S1 (+S2/U3), FS1, U5 GPS, U4, U6, U9 or Wi-Fi
U3, QS1–QS3, TS1, Q1–Q5, SV1, U4, U6
everything; any sensor may be missing
Wiring tips: I²C at 400 kHz, keep I²C wires < 30 cm; sensor cables use shielded 3-core,
shield to GND at the node end only; star-ground the analog returns at the ADS1115s.
C9 100nF: TDS_OUT to GND, at U3.
